summary: Innate Pharma SA filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 10, 2026, announcing a conference call and webcast on September 17, 2026, to present first-half 2026 financial results and a business update. Management participants include CEO Jonathan Dickinson, CMO Markus Jensen, COO Yannis Morel and CFO Frédéric Lombard. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, structural mechanic or regulatory clock is disclosed. The item is a routine scheduling notice equivalent to a US Form 8-K investor-event announcement; no special-situation angle, and the arbitrage watch is limited to any pipeline or partnership commentary on the call.
